component.source: owner directive V16.4 §2 ODG GO + §7 close the loop + §10 scenario J
invariants: one bounded cycle per invocation (maxSteps ≤ 10, wall-clock deadline); no loop, no timer, no second scheduler
Truth-Lock refusal ⇒ STARTUP_REFUSED before any state read
selection is the selector's (TIE_EXPLAINED / DECISION_REQUIRED kept; never an id pick)
ODG never self-authorizes: execution only through schedulerStep with an external authorization or the canonical pre-authorized allowlist
dispatch only in mode EXECUTE, only for NATIVE work in an isolated workspace; PROVIDER/HYBRID ⇒ delegation RECORD only; no provider launch
no commit, no merge, no write outside the out dir (writer guard); ledger/attempt-log read-only
stop between every step: ODG_SCHEDULER_STOP=1, STOP file / signal port, deadline, max steps — each recorded in the trace
idempotent re-run: same state ⇒ same decisions digest (duplicateOf); a (runId, mission) is never dispatched twice

I.scenario: V16.4 §10 I — ODG sélectionne et prépare la mission suivante

criteria.test: the real dry cycle's SELECT step is mission-priority-selector.selectNextExplained over odg-strategic-register built from the real repo state; decision SELECTED or TIE_EXPLAINED (tiedSet + resolvedBy recorded) — never an id pick; the selected item is not owner-gated

the selected item is PREPARED: NEXT_SELECTION.preparedMission carries the contract (objective, write_set, acceptance_criteria), the decomposition-planner verdict, the strategy-mode-selector verdict and an explicit authorizationNeeded when unauthorized
consistency: the SELECT decision equals the committed V164_STRATEGIC_REGISTER decisionRecord and the STRATEGY verdict equals the committed V164_STRATEGY_MODE_SELECTION entry for that item
the selector's next choice after the current item is recorded (NEXT_SELECTION.nextAfterCurrent)

I.gradingRule: FAIL if I1 fails or an owner-gated item is selected; PASS iff I1–I4 pass; otherwise PARTIAL (a DECISION_REQUIRED that is explained ⇒ PARTIAL)

J.scenario: V16.4 §10 J — le bouton GO déclenche réellement ce cycle, avec traces et possibilité d'arrêt

criteria.test: a real `odg-go` run (child process) on the real repo state performs the 10 steps in order, each STEP trace entry carrying step, inputsSha256, decision, rationale, decidedBy, startedAt, endedAt

unauthorized work halts at the authorization gate: AUTHORIZE stops the intelligence loop at PROPOSED for the unauthorized selected item, and EXECUTE records NOTHING_EXECUTED (or the run is HALTED_DECISION_REQUIRED)

nothing unauthorized executed: dispatchCalls=0 and providerLaunched=0 in every run whose selected item is unauthorized; every file written by every run is inside its --out dir; the main checkout's git status and mission-ledger sha256 are unchanged
a STOP file created mid-cycle (after ≥3 steps) stops the real run before step 10 with a STOP trace entry and CYCLE_END status STOPPED
SIGTERM sent mid-cycle (after ≥3 steps) stops the real run cleanly: STOP trace entry + CYCLE_END STOPPED, process exit code 3
canonical emergency stop ODG_SCHEDULER_STOP=1 ⇒ STOPPED with trace; --max-steps and --deadline-ms bounds ⇒ STOPPED (MAX_STEPS / DEADLINE) with trace
re-running the same dry cycle on the same state is idempotent: same runId + same decisionsDigest, CYCLE_END.idempotent=true (duplicateOf recorded), no dispatch

EXECUTE path proven for real: an `--execute` run dispatches a canonically authorized NATIVE mission in an isolated scratch worktree and records its verified outcome — NOT_MEASURED when no canonically authorized native mission exists (an authorization is never created to make it pass)

J.gradingRule: FAIL if any of J1–J7 fails; PASS iff J1–J7 pass AND J8 passes; J8 NOT_MEASURED ⇒ PARTIAL (the governed cycle and its stop are proven; the execution leg is not)

odgComponents: mission-scheduler.evaluateEligibility/schedulerStep (allowlist, proven dedup, emergency stop, dispatch gate)
providerRules: the 10-step order and the composition itself (odg-go-cycle.ts)
GO-DEC-1 (provider rule): spec.architecture = one entry per WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.write_set path (role = objective, contract = acceptance_criteria joined); no contract ⇒ NOT_MEASURED
stop rules (STOP file, signals, deadline, max steps) and the out-dir confinement
the state reader (which files are canonical inputs) and the allowlist source order (env → installed unit → repo unit)
the pre-registered I/J criteria and this harness
the decisions-digest definition (excludes TRUTH_LOCK git details and the volatile attempt-log size)

honestLimits: J8 NOT_MEASURED: no canonically authorized NATIVE mission exists, so the dispatch leg (odg-run in an isolated scratch worktree) was never exercised for real — it is covered only by offline tests with injected ports
the selected item and its preparation are a PROPOSAL; ODG did not (and cannot) authorize it; whether the prepared mission would succeed is not measured

state is read from the main checkout READ-ONLY (Truth-Lock passes there); the code runs from the feature worktree, whose own Truth-Lock refuses (branch ≠ main) — recorded as run truthLockOnCodeTree; loaders that read the code tree (strategy-mode evaluation instant) are parity-checked against the state repo (STATE_READ codeTreeParity)
the canonical allowlist was read from the installed systemd unit file (read-only); in CI/another host the source and therefore runId differ — --check is host-dependent
stop is cooperative (between steps); a step already running (e.g. a dispatched odg-run) is bounded by its own timeout, not interrupted
the live root timer appends to the attempt-log independently; its size is recorded as volatile and excluded from the decisions digest
pre-registration is in the same commit as the first evidence write; its precedence is asserted, not cryptographically provable
